name: Systemic Eye
tagline: Where the Body Meets the Eye
description: Diabetes, hypertension, autoimmune disease, thyroid, HIV, tuberculosis, syphilis, sarcoidosis, carotid disease — the eye as a window to systemic health.

episodes.title: The Eye as the Window: The Systemic Exam at the Fundus
episodes.description: Why every dilated exam is a systemic screen and the communication with the primary care physician.

episodes.title: Diabetes: The Microvascular Cascade From Retinopathy to Edema
episodes.description: The pathophysiology, the staging, and the glycemic and blood pressure control that changes the trajectory.

episodes.title: Diabetic Eye Care: The Annual Exam and the Beyond
episodes.description: The screening schedule, the telehealth role, and the pregnancy and renal escalation.

episodes.title: Hypertension: The Keith-Wagener-Barker Classification
episodes.description: The arteriolar narrowing, the AV nicking, the cotton-wool and flame hemorrhage, and the crisis.

episodes.title: Hypertensive Retinopathy: The End-Organ Damage at the Eye
episodes.description: The grading, the systemic risk, and the patient and physician communication that follows.

episodes.title: Carotid Disease: The Eye and the Stroke Risk
episodes.description: The Hollenhorst plaque, the amaurosis fugax, and the carotid Doppler and surgical decision.

episodes.title: Ocular Ischemic Syndrome: The Under-Recognized Hypoperfusion
episodes.description: The midperipheral hemorrhage, the neovascularization, and the carotid stenosis workup.

episodes.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis and the Eye: The Dry Eye and the Scleritis
episodes.description: The sicca, the episcleritis and scleritis, and the systemic immunosuppression coordination.

episodes.title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: The Retinopathy and the Hydroxychloroquine
episodes.description: The cotton-wool spots, the antimalarial toxicity surveillance, and the interdisciplinary care.

episodes.title: Sjögren’s Syndrome: The Sicca and the Systemic
episodes.description: The dry eye and dry mouth, the SSA/SSB, and the rheumatology referral and lymphoma risk.

episodes.title: Thyroid Eye Disease: The Grave’s Connection
episodes.description: The orbitopathy, the restrictive myopathy, and the endocrine and orbital co-management.

episodes.title: Giant Cell Arteritis: The Systemic Vasculitis at the Eye
episodes.description: The polymyalgia, the jaw claudication, the steroid, and the temporal artery biopsy and rheumatology.

episodes.title: Multiple Sclerosis: The Optic Neuritis and the Long View
episodes.description: The ONTT, the MRI decision, the disease-modifying therapy era, and the optometric surveillance.

episodes.title: Sarcoidosis: The Granulomatous Disease and the Eye
episodes.description: The uveitis, the conjunctival biopsy, the ACE, and the pulmonary and systemic coordination.

episodes.title: Syphilis: The Great Imitator in Eye Care
episodes.description: The resurgence, the panuveitis, the RPR and FTA-ABS, and the intravenous penicillin.

episodes.title: Tuberculosis: The Endemic and the Latent
episodes.description: The IGRA, the chest CT, the latent treatment before biologics, and the uveitis that follows.

episodes.title: HIV and the Eye: From CMV to Immune Recovery Uveitis
episodes.description: The opportunistic infections, the HAART transformation, and the immune recovery uveitis paradox.

episodes.title: Lyme Disease: The Tick-Borne and the Endemic
episodes.description: The erythema migrans, the ELISA and Western blot, and the ocular and neurologic manifestations.

episodes.title: Toxoplasmosis: The Congenital and the Acquired
episodes.description: The cat and the undercooked meat, the necrotizing retinitis, and the treatment and recurrence.

episodes.title: Toxocariasis: The Nematode and the Child
episodes.description: The larva migrans, the granuloma, the ELISA, and the differential from retinoblastoma.

episodes.title: Sickle Cell Disease: The Sea-Fan and the Hemorrhage
episodes.description: The retinal vascular occlusion, the proliferative retinopathy, and the scatter laser and surgery.

episodes.title: Leukemia and Lymphoma: The Systemic Malignancy at the Eye
episodes.description: The retinal infiltrates, the choroidal involvement, and the oncology and pathology coordination.

episodes.title: Marfan Syndrome: The Lens and the Aorta
episodes.description: The superolateral lens subluxation, the tall stature, and the cardiac surveillance and genetics.

episodes.title: Ehlers-Danlos and the Eye: The Connective Tissue Link
episodes.description: The blue sclera, the elastic skin, and the refractive and angioid streaks associations.

episodes.title: Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum: The Angioid Streaks and the Skin
episodes.description: The plucked-chicken skin, the retinal streaks, and the cardiovascular and GI surveillance.

episodes.title: Pregnancy and the Eye: The Physiologic and the Pathologic
episodes.description: The refractive shift, the contact lens intolerance, the diabetic and hypertensive change, and the postpartum.

episodes.title: Medication-Induced Ocular Disease: The Chronic Patient
episodes.description: Hydroxychloroquine, ethambutol, amiodarone, tamoxifen — the surveillance schedule and the cessation.

episodes.title: Nutritional Optic Neuropathy: The Deficiency and the Recovery
episodes.description: The B12 and thiamine and copper deficiencies, the tobacco-alcohol amblyopia, and the supplementation.

episodes.title: Wilson Disease: The Kayser-Fleischer Ring
episodes.description: The copper accumulation, the Descemet ring, and the hepatic and neurologic management.

episodes.title: The Systemic Eye Exam: The Report and the Referral
episodes.description: The written communication to the primary care and specialist, the urgency, and the shared care plan.
